response.overview: Three days before Zalia's wedding ceremony, she was raped by a robber who broke into her rented house. Zalia confesses and pleads with her fiancé, Zaidi, not to cancel their wedding because of the rape. Zaidi agrees on the condition that Zalia must become his servant and serve him like a king. A month passes, and Zalia is confirmed to be pregnant. Zaidi says the child in Zalia's womb is the child of the rapist who raped her. Zalia reminds her husband that the rape occurred five months ago and she has only been pregnant for a month. As a result, Zalia is beaten until she miscarries. What is the outcome?
response.title: Muliakah Aku
